definition: he who is holding a plough, as a farmer.
example_en: The plough-bearer rose in the morning and went to the field.

definition: a forked tongue (as of a snake).
example_en: The snake's forked tongue flickered in the air.

definition: to project (something) through the air or space with usu. sudden force, from the hand or arm; to throw; to cast.
example_en: He threw a stone into the river.

definition: extreme, often indignant, contempt for someone or something; utter disdain; scorn.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಆಳಿ ಎದ್ದುಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Utter scorn for everyone was evident in his words.

definition: anything that is red in colour.
example_en: She held a red flower in her hand.

definition: a particoloured thing.
example_en: He showed a particoloured bird.

definition: the cardinal number ten thousand; a myriad.
example: ಆ ದೇಶದ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಒಂದು ಅಯುತಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The population of that country was more than ten thousand.

definition: the cutting edge of a sword; the blade.
example_en: The blacksmith sharpened the blade of the sword well.

definition: a written agreement; a treaty.
example: ಎರಡು ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ತಹನಾಮೆಗೆ ಸಹಿ ಹಾಕಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: A treaty was signed between the two kingdoms.

definition: an acute communicable disease, caused by a virus and characterised by swelling of the salivary glands; mumps.
example_en: The child got mumps and his cheek swelled up.

definition: an offspring of śudra man from a brāhmaṇa woman.
example_en: The story of the caṇḍāḷa is written in the purāṇa.

definition: the back portion of anything.
example_en: The back portion of the house was dark.

definition: the front part of the head, from the forehead to the chin; the face.
example_en: Joy was clearly visible on her face.

definition: the science of numbers; the art of reckoning by figures; arithmetic.
example_en: Arithmetic is taught to children at school.

definition: of good, appreciable quality.
example_en: This cloth is of good, appreciable quality.

definition: the act of swallowing (something) into the stomach.
example_en: Swallowing the medicine is not easy.

definition: a specialist or expert in grammar; a grammarian.
example_en: That grammarian teaches grammar in the school.

definition: a man who cuts (grain crop) with a scythe, sickle, etc.; a reaper.
example_en: The reaper cut the paddy with a sickle.

definition: to keep (different things) together; to accumulate.
example_en: She kept all her books accumulated together in one place.

definition: Vāraṇāsi, in Northern India, a holy city for Hindus.
example_en: Varanasi is a holy city in northern India.

definition: (astrol.) the result or the influence of a sign of the zodiac on a person.
example_en: The astrologer explained the influence of the zodiac sign on him.

definition: freely; unobstructedly; unrestrictedly.
example_en: The children moved about freely in the playground.

definition: a lawless, a vicious or depraved person; a socially harmful fellow.
example: ಆ ಪುಂಡುಪೋಕರಿ ಊರಿನ ಜನರಿಗೆ ಸದಾ ತೊಂದರೆ ಕೊಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That lawless ruffian always troubled the people of the town.

definition: to evince prowess, manliness; to exhibit one's valour.
example_en: He displayed his prowess before the opponent.

definition: the rear or hinder part of anything; back.
example: ಮನೆಯ ಹಿಂದು ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಪುಟ್ಟ ತೋಟವಿದೆ.
example_en: There is a small garden at the back part of the house.

definition: zinc sulphate; white vitriol.
example_en: Zinc sulphate is used in medicine preparation.

definition: having embroidery work done with gold, silver or silk threads).
example_en: The bride wore an embroidered sari.

definition: the liquid waste discharged from the body; urine.
example_en: The patient's urine was sent for testing.

definition: a woman who has not remarried after the death of her husband; a widow.
example_en: That widow was living her life alone.

definition: a repetition of sound produced by the reflection of sound waves from a wall, mountain or other obstructing surface; an echo.
example_en: When he shouted inside the cave, a clear echo was heard.

definition: a portable earthen oven.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡುಗೆಗೆ ಎತ್ತೊಲೆ ಜೊತೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಹೋದರು.
example_en: They took a portable earthen oven along for cooking during the journey.

definition: any small, rounded, usu. inflamed swelling of the skin; a papule or pustule; a pimple.
example_en: A pimple appeared on the girl's face.

definition: name of a tribe, which is included in the Schedule to the Indian Constitution.
example_en: People of the Erava tribe live in the forest.

definition: the prime youthful stage of a person.
example_en: He is in the prime of his youth.

definition: that which is somewhat salty.
example_en: The water of this well is somewhat salty.

definition: to boil with a vehement bubbling sound.
example_en: The milk boiled with a vehement bubbling sound and overflowed on the stove.

definition: a figure of a person in old clothes, stuffed with hay, set up to frighten crows or other birds away from crops; a scarecrow.
example_en: The farmer set up a scarecrow in the field.

definition: a domesticated cat.
example_en: Our domesticated cat was drinking milk.

definition: a gun, fired from the shoulder, with spiral grooves cut into the inner surface of the barrel.
example_en: The hunter set out with the gun on his shoulder.

definition: surrounded; encircled.
example_en: That fort was surrounded by a deep moat.

definition: conformity to usage, custom or law.
example_en: The worship was conducted in conformity with tradition.

definition: a mark left on the skin after a wound has healed.
example: ಗಾಯ ಮಾಸಿದ ಬಳಿಕ ಕೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪುಣ್ಗಲೆ ಉಳಿಯಿತು.
example_en: After the wound healed, a scar remained on his hand.

definition: to be paired with; to form a match.
example_en: The two players formed a good match in the game.

definition: without uttering a single word; silently.
example: ಅವನು ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿದರೂ ಅವಳು ಗಪ್‍ಚಿಪ್ ಆಗಿ ಕುಳಿತಳು.
example_en: Even though he asked a question, she sat silently without a word.

definition: the artistic beauty of the colours, shades used in painting a picture.
example_en: The artistic beauty of colours in that painting enchanted the viewers.

definition: the act or process of preparing, making ready.
example_en: The preparations needed for the wedding have already begun.

definition: a particular kind of distillation of medicinal substances.
example_en: The physicians gave the patient the kurmaputa-distilled medicine.

definition: a water reservoir.
example_en: The villagers used to fetch water from the reservoir.

definition: a man who writes poems; a poet.
example_en: The author (kavya kartri) of this book was a famous poet.

definition: a longing or craving, as for something; a desire.
example_en: He tried to fulfill her desire.

definition: to twist or wind.
example_en: He twisted the rope tightly.

definition: any of various decapods with four pairs of legs, one pair of pincers, a flattish shell, and a short, broad abdomen folded under its thorax; a crab.
example_en: A crab was walking along the seashore.

definition: the act of treading heavily; a trampling.
example_en: The crops in the field were destroyed by the elephant's heavy trampling.

definition: the state of being completely nude.
example_en: The child was playing in a completely nude state.

definition: to weigh in the mind; to evaluate the wroth, significance, importance or the consequences etc.
example_en: The consequences of this decision must be carefully weighed.

definition: the quality or condition of being straight; absence of crookedness; straightness.
example_en: The straightness of this road has made the journey easy.

definition: mixed; mingled; blended; combined.
example_en: There is a mixed-colored liquid in this vessel.

definition: a hollow object, usu. cuplike, made of metal or other hard material, with a clapper inside, which rings when struck; a bell.
example_en: The temple bell was ringing since morning.

definition: a stroke; a blow.
example_en: The stroke of that stone fell on the head.

definition: great danger; peril; jeopardy.
example_en: Great peril came upon the ship because of the storm.

definition: the front part of anything.
example_en: The front part of the arrow was very sharp.

definition: the shape of a circle; roundness.
example: ಆ ಕೊಳದ ವಲಯಾಕೃತಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The circular shape of that pond drew everyone's attention.

definition: a luminous body falling on the earth's surface during day-time; a meteor.
example_en: Seeing a daytime meteor in the sunlight, the people became alarmed.

definition: to incite, urge to fight.
example: ಅವನು ಇಬ್ಬರು ಸ್ನೇಹಿತರನ್ನು ಕಲಹಿಸಿ ಜಗಳ ಬೆಳೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: He incited the two friends and started a quarrel.

definition: to construct a flight of stairs.
example_en: The contractor constructed a new flight of stairs for the building.

definition: a small boat.
example_en: The fisherman sat in the small boat and set out to sea.

definition: to walk or move hither and thither with or without a purpose.
example_en: In the evening the two of them strolled about in the garden.

definition: smooth and sweet sounding speech.
example_en: Her smooth and sweet speech captivated the listeners' minds.

definition: a votive lamp fixed at a place.
example_en: They lit the votive lamp near the temple.

definition: a kissing by pressing one's lips to the lips of another.
example_en: He gave her a kiss on the lips lovingly.

definition: to become smaller or contract oneself as by the action of moisture, heat, cold or fear; to shrink; to recoil.
example_en: His hands shrank from the cold.

definition: confidence in oneself, one's own abilities, etc.; self-confidence.
example_en: Self-confidence is needed before the exam.

definition: a causing to happen; execution.
example_en: The execution of the project took three years.

definition: (a pointed instrument) to be planted into; to pierce through an object.
example_en: The thorn pierced into his foot.

definition: to have hole or holes.
example_en: The wall developed holes during the rainy season.

definition: water in which limestone is boiling.
example_en: The steam from the limestone-boiling water filled the whole room.

definition: a piece; a cut; a segment.
example_en: Give me a piece of the fruit.

definition: revolt against or forcible resistance to a legally constituted system or any authority; mutiny.
example_en: The soldiers rose in revolt against the king.

definition: the act of speaking slightingly of; disparagement; belittlement.
example_en: His disparaging words hurt everyone.

definition: the whitish mass of bubbles formed on or in liquids by agitation, fermentation, etc.; foam.
example: ಸಮುದ್ರದ ಅಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಳಿಯ ನೊರೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: White foam was visible on the sea waves.

definition: inflammation of the mucus membrane of the mouth; stomatitis.
example_en: Stomatitis causes pain in the mouth.

definition: the final agreement, arrangement or adjustment.
example: ಎರಡೂ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳು ಒಪ್ಪಂದದ ಕಂಡಣೆಗೆ ಸಹಿ ಹಾಕಿದವು.
example_en: Both parties signed the final agreement of the contract.

definition: a tropical plant, Ricinus communis of Euphorbiaceae family; castor plant.
example_en: A castor plant has grown behind the house.

definition: the upper portion or the area, region, etc. that is above(something).
example_en: I had kept the book on the top of the table.

definition: (hist.) a unit of weight (equal to three tolas).
example: ಅಂಗಡಿಯವನು ಒಂದು ಪಲ ಬಂಗಾರವನ್ನು ತೂಕ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The shopkeeper weighed one pala of gold.

definition: amounting to ten in number; ten.
example_en: There were ten mangoes in the basket.

definition: to pervade through out; to spread oneself all over.
example_en: The noise of the fair pervaded the whole town.

definition: a small cake of sulphur.
example_en: They were selling small sulphur cakes at the medicine shop.

definition: to become thick lump; to be clotted.
example_en: When the milk became hot, it clotted into lumps.

definition: a man who has invested capital in a business enterprise; an investor; a capitalist.
example_en: The capitalist established a new company.

definition: the act of stopping, preventing.
example_en: The quarrel stopped because of his intervention.

definition: to fall into a faint; to faint away.
example_en: He fainted away due to the heat of the sun.

definition: inclined or ready to quarrel, fight, make arguments; contentious; quarrelsome.
example: ಆ ಪೋರ್ಕುಳಿ ಹುಡುಗ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ಜಗಳ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That contentious boy is always looking for a fight.

definition: he who is given to excessive sexual indulgency; a lewd man.
example_en: Being a lewd man, he would become lustful whenever he saw women.

definition: a cosmetic paste for colouring the lips, with the help of a stick set in a case.
example_en: She applied the lip colour to her lips with the stick.

definition: fate or destiny (resulting from merit or demerit in former life).
example_en: Everything turned out well because of his fate.

definition: a house on a farm; esp., the main dwelling house on a farm; a farm-house.
example_en: Their farm-house stands in the middle of the field.

definition: to make (something) to be or become firm, stable; to fix firmly.
example_en: The engineer made the bridge firm and stable.

definition: skill in archery.
example: ರಾಜನಿಗೆ ಆ ಯುವಕನ ಬಿಲ್ವೆಸನ್ ಬಹಳ ಇಷ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The king liked that young man's skill in archery very much.

definition: the illustrious power, strength or valour.
example_en: That hero's illustrious valour was an example to everyone.

definition: a violent, involuntary contraction or spasm of the muscles; convulsions.
example: ಜ್ವರದ ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ರಾಯಸನ್ನಿ ಕೂಡ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: Along with the fever, he also had convulsions.

definition: a line or long, thin mark; stripe or smear; a streak.
example: ಗೋಡೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆಂಪು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಗೀಟು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a red streak on the wall.

definition: extreme coldness.
example_en: There is extreme coldness in the Himalayan region.

definition: an inverted "U" shaped tile used at the point where two roofs, sloping differently, join together.
example_en: They fixed the ridge tile at the junction of the roof.

definition: (mus.) a particular system of keeping time in music.
example_en: The rhythmic system of that song was unique.

definition: seen; look at; observed.
example_en: The incident had been observed by witnesses.

definition: the act or an instance of harassing or troubling; annoyance; persecution.
example: ಅವನ ಕೊರಿಪಿಡಿಯಿಂದ ಬೇಸತ್ತು ಕೆಲಸಗಾರ ಊರು ಬಿಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: Tired of his harassment (koripiḍi), the worker left the town.

definition: a playing card having conventionalised designs or representation of a heart.
example_en: He picked up the heart card from the playing cards.

definition: one's wife's or husbanḍs younger brother.
example_en: My wife's younger brother had also come for the wedding.

definition: the plant Phoebe wightii of Lauraceae family.
example: ಆ ಗುಡ್ಡದ ತಪ್ಪಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊರಮಾವು ಮರ ಕಾಣಸಿಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The koramavu tree is found at the foot of that hill.

definition: the act or an instance of bending.
example_en: The bending of the tree branch increased with the wind.

definition: involving one dimension only; linear.
example_en: This line indicates a one-dimensional (linear) measurement.

definition: a group of people, animals, things, etc.; a multitude.
example_en: A multitude of people had gathered at the fair.

definition: to consider or regard as worthless, useless.
example_en: He regarded that work as worthless and abandoned it.

definition: a umbrella or the like made of the feathers of peacocks.
example: ರಾಜನ ಮೇಲೆ ಪೀಲಿದಳೆ ಹಿಡಿದ ಸೇವಕರು ನಡೆದರು.
example_en: The servants walked holding the peacock-feather umbrella over the king.

definition: a knot of the hair on the scalp.
example: ಅವಳ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಎಣಗಂಟು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a knot of hair on her scalp.

definition: a (piece of ) silk cloth.
example: ರಾಣಿ ಕ್ಷೌಮ ವಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನು ಧರಿಸಿ ಸಭೆಗೆ ಬಂದಳು.
example_en: The queen came to the assembly wearing a silk garment.

definition: to be noisy; to make continuous, confusing, indistinct sounds; to buzz.
example_en: People were making a confused buzzing noise in the market.

definition: (a commodity) to be sold .
example_en: All the fruits were quickly sold at the market.

definition: the life, esp. the problems and woes, of women.
example_en: That novel depicts the hardships of a woman's life.

definition: shining in the dark like phosphorus; phosphorescent.
example_en: That mineral was glowing phosphorescently in the dark.

definition: a rail-road.
example_en: The passengers were waiting on the platform for the train.

definition: a man who invades (another's country) with a military force to take away wealth; an invader.
example_en: The invader crossed the border with his army.

definition: a good, kind master.
example_en: A good master looks after his servants with love.

definition: the last part or end.
example_en: The ending of the story surprised everyone.

definition: a pain inflicted on one's feelings.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತು ನನ್ನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಗಾರು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His words caused pain to my feelings.

definition: range or field of vision.
example: ಎತ್ತರದ ಗುಡ್ಡದಿಂದ ಇಡೀ ಊರು ಕಣ್ಬೊಲದೊಳಗೆ ಬಂತು.
example_en: From the tall hill, the whole town came within the field of vision.

definition: a wealthy man.
example_en: The wealthy man distributed his property to his children.

definition: the large vulture Gyps bengalensis of Acciptridae family, with bald-head, naked neck, white back and shoulder, large wings, short but strong curved beak, black legs, that feeds on dead animals; Indian white-backed vulure.
example: ರಣಪದ್ದು ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಎತ್ತರದ ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The vulture was perched on a tall tree in the distance.

definition: any disease that is communicated or communicable from one person to another or others; a communicable, transmittable disease.
example_en: That communicable disease spread quickly in the village.

definition: a prolonged or serious shortage or deficiency, caused by a prolonged period of dry weather; drought; famine.
example_en: All the crops dried up due to the drought.

definition: a man who makes, repairs or alters clothes; a tailor.
example_en: The tailor stitched my shirt well.

definition: a bird, akin to crow, resembling the pheasant; a crow-pheasant.
example_en: The crow-pheasant was moving about near the field.

definition: the act of breaking.
example_en: The sound of the glass breaking was heard.

definition: to be charmed greatly; to enchanted.
example_en: Hearing the music, he sat greatly enchanted.

definition: a coin of very small or negligible value.
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ಕಿಗ್ಗಾಣಿಗೆ ಈಗ ಯಾವ ಬೆಲೆಯೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That old coin of negligible value has no worth now.

definition: a heap of beds, placed one above the other.
example_en: They had prepared a heap of stacked beds for the guests.

definition: two pouches connected at one side of their mouth so that it can be put on the back of an animal or on one's shoulder and in both things can be filled.
example: ಪ್ರಯಾಣಿಕ ಹಸಿಬೆಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆಹಾರ ತುಂಬಿದನು.
example_en: The traveler filled the shoulder pouch with clothes and food.

definition: the act or instance of dying; death.
example_en: The news of the great soul's death spread everywhere.

definition: the quality of being reticent, reserve; reservedness; a holding back from talking or mingling with others.
example_en: Seeing her reservedness, no one spoke to her.

definition: having something (that adds grace) as a digit (a phase) of the moon.
example_en: The crescent moon shone graced with its digit of light.

definition: the snout of a pig.
example_en: The pig's snout was buried in the mud.

definition: a thin, flexible material made usu. in sheets from a pulp prepared from rags, wood or other fibrous material, and used for writing or printing on, for packaging, as wrapping material, structural material, etc.; a paper.
example_en: He wrote a letter on paper.

definition: an engineer - a) a person who operates or supervises the operation of engines or technical equipment; b) a specialist in planning and directing operations in some technical field; c) a member of a military engineering unit trained in the construction and demolition of bridges, roads, airfields, etc.; d) a specialist in software.
example: ಆ ಇಂಜನೀಯರು ಸೇತುವೆ ನಿರ್ಮಾಣದ ಉಸ್ತುವಾರಿ ವಹಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: That engineer has taken charge of the bridge construction.

definition: the state or quality of being hard (as a metal).
example_en: The hardness of this iron is very great.

definition: a calling by name.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕರು ಪ್ರತಿ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯ ನಾಮಗ್ರಹ ಮಾಡಿ ಹಾಜರಾತಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡರು.
example_en: The teacher took attendance by calling each student's name.

definition: a fight between two bulls.
example_en: A fight between two bulls took place at the village fair.

definition: the act of cutting, severing or seperating (from the whole); a cutting.
example_en: The gardener made a cutting of the plant's branch.

definition: the knowledge or feeling of being apart from, not being united, associated, connected with, others; separateness.
example_en: A sense of separateness grew between the two of them.

definition: a sudden, sharp pain caused by involuntary contraction of a muscle or muscles from chill, strain, etc.; cramp.
example_en: Her arm got a cramp while she was swimming.

definition: to jump from above to a lower place.
example_en: He jumped down from the tree and ran away.

definition: to wear an armour.
example_en: The warrior wore his armour before going to the battlefield.

definition: a going ahead; a moving forward.
example_en: The forward progress of the project is happening rapidly.

definition: to cause to wear (an ornament, dress, shackles, etc.) 2.to place in a sitting or convenient position; to set.
example_en: They made him wear a new shirt.

definition: to spread, diffuse all over immediately.
example_en: The sparks spread at once and caught the hay.

definition: the quality or state of being free from anxiety, disquietness, apprehension, concern, metal agitation, etc.; calmness; tranquility; quietude.
example_en: In the evening, the mind found tranquility.

definition: to shake (something, continuously or repeatedly).
example_en: He rocked the baby in the cradle.

definition: a variety in sesbana tree (akin to Sesbania grandiflora).
example: ಮನೆಯ ಮುಂದೆ ಒಂದು ಕೆನ್ನಗಸೆ ಮರ ಬೆಳೆದಿದೆ.
example_en: A red-flowered sesbania tree has grown in front of the house.

definition: the act or fact of dropping; sudden fall, descent, slump or decrease; a drop.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆಯ ಇಳುವರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕುಗ್ಗು ಕಂಡುಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: A big drop was seen in the crop yield this year.

definition: the act of pouring (a liquid) down or into.
example_en: The priest poured the holy water into the vessel.

definition: (the throat) to make indistinct sound (while being cleared).
example_en: He made an indistinct sound while clearing his throat.

definition: bursting into pieces; in a shattered or strewn condition.
example_en: The glass vessel fell and broke into shattered pieces.

definition: a hollow formation or place; a depressed or sunken part.
example_en: There was a depressed hollow in the middle of the field.

definition: intense fear; dread; terror.

example_en: From the hilltop his gaze at the higher place turned toward the village.

definition: the process or result of thinking or meditating; thought; deep meditation.

definition: to cut, sever completely.

example_en: He severed the rope completely in one stroke.

definition: the evergreen tree Olea dioca of Oleaceae family; Indian wild olive.

definition: without interest being charged.

definition: a god; a deity.
